name: Explore the Graffities of Atlantis - Abandoned Aquatic Park in Mexico City!
author: BenoitEncounters
description:
YouTube video of our exploration (Intro): https://youtu.be/6s-EeZ12cu4

Use WASD on your keyboard and your mouse to move around like in a video game and become an urban explorer yourself!

On mobile, go to: https://hub.link/maDiwdr

Atlantis is an abandoned aquatic park in Mexico City, which has become half forbidden half a spot to visit. Artists go there to make graffiti, street art, as well as music videos, and more! The maze-like style of the place made it particularly interesting for me to scan because I am in search of making interactive videos and experiences that are participatory. But unlike video games, my content is sourced in reality and has a documentary approach to it. The idea is to enable the audience to explore places by themselves.

My Fujifilm DSLR camera kit which I used for the 3D scan (6K resolution): https://amzn.to/3hnVHMA
If it's out of stock you can get the former model (cheaper and just as good): https://amzn.to/3AaXwFj
